name: [🎉 RELEASE] Doodle Tower Defense
desc:
🖍️ Welcome to Doodle Tower Defense!

Every unit is a HAND-DRAWN doodle! ✏️

How to Play:
🎲 Summon doodles and collect all 35!
🧟 Place your doodles and stop the zombie horde!
⬆️ Upgrade and evolve your doodles!
👹 Beat giant bosses like the Brute!
👫 Team up with friends to defend together!

🔥 Try BOSS RUSH and DRAFT MODE!

👍 Like the game and ⭐ Favorite for new doodles and maps!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players

Tags: Tower Defense, TD, Doodle, Drawing, Zombies, Summon, Strategy
